briefing: Uranus is a planet that spins on its side.
Most planets spin like a top, but Uranus rolls like a ball.
That means its seasons last for years: one pole faces the sun for a very long time while the other pole sits in the dark.
Uranus is pale blue and very cold.
Its rings are thin and dark, and hard to see.
preflightLine: Everything out here is tilted. Don't worry about which way is up. Just read.
warpSentence: Uranus is a planet that spins on its side.
